challenge.better_approach: Reusing tickets_root was tried and measured: it bends _TICKETS_ROOT, a cairn-root that ticket_path derives <parent>/CairnCommons/tickets from. crossing_named_ticket and four other judges read _tf._TICKETS through find_ticket, so passing tickets_root left the proof red. Making find_ticket's judges read ticket_path would mean relaying every fixture as <base>/CairnCommons and would touch five judges. A separate named root that maps onto the one documented patch point is smaller.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That nothing else differs between the in-process fixture and the launched world for these proofs. Measured only for test_the_stones_are_pushed. test_transitions has 14 launches and may need other roots, so the builder measures each red tooth's failure after the bend.
challenge.prior_art: 7bc219108b8f is the same pattern for questions_root and artifact_roots, and 0c2c3f53c2be D3/D4 for berths/tickets_root/crossing_roots: a named launch root mapped to an env var, read only under a scratch HOME. Neither names ticket_file._TICKETS. 8627334b2 is where the in-process patch stopped reaching the judge.
challenge.real_collision: d2ecdb867bc9 (an environment-bent root redirecting live writes). It is avoided the way 0c2c D4 avoids it: the env is read only through _root_override, which refuses under the account's own HOME. A distinction, not a collision.

answers.falsifier: A launched CodeMother given ticket_store resolves find_ticket against it, and without it reads her own store. Under the account's own HOME the bend is refused. The three proofs go green under bin/cairn test. If they stay red with the store bent, the cause is elsewhere and this was the wrong intent.
answers.from_idea: none, because the red was measured directly in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_stones_are_pushed.py at origin/main 175c1107c, reported by akienasus's 149b9a1ab9c4 PROVEME walk
answers.how: Add ticket_store to inspect_wire.ROOT_ENV, _launch_env and launch, as env CAIRN_BUILD_INSPECTOR_TICKET_STORE. Inspector.py reads it through _root_override, the scratch-HOME guard, right after it imports ticket_file as _tf, and sets _tf._TICKETS. The three proofs pass ticket_store=<the dir they already patch in-process> on each launch. A prototype on origin/main turned test_the_stones_are_pushed green.
answers.traces_to: Law 8: nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass. These three proofs red for a fixture that no longer reaches the judge, not for the code they measure, and they hold 149b9a1ab9c4 at PROVEME.
answers.what: A CodeMother launched by inspect_wire.launch finds a proof's fixture tickets: launch takes a ticket_store root, and the inspector points ticket_file._TICKETS at it under a scratch HOME. So test_the_stones_are_pushed, test_transitions and test_entry_gate_jurisdiction no longer red on 'widget is not cast'.

bullets.text: 8627334b2 moved seven proofs from in-process fixture() to a launched CodeMother. Their in-process ticket_file._TICKETS patch no longer reaches the judge, so 'widget' reads as not cast. Prototype: a ticket_store root greens test_the_stones_are_pushed.
